context: All59 Japanese literals from5 archives; three heart and three star reward paths, placement/growth/strengthening and mission failure read.
voice: Cheerful Roll/StarMan, solemn ThunderMan, steady WoodMan, apologetic formal ProtoMan, neutral reward narration. Candidate wording not approved.
insertion_state: translation-first draft only; not selected by ROM builder
protected_policy: Keep item33 amount1, item7/item6 labels, zenny/bug amounts4294967295 with buffer3, printCurrentNavi/nickname, 10-frame dot waits, object vs scene animations24/25 and RollHeart/StarDataErase calls.
semantic_review: Heart/star paths0/1/2 award strengthening program/zenny/bug fragments respectively; no randomized reward type or amount hardcoded. Timed dot literals remain individually authored dots, not removed prose.
Roll nickname+comma stays separate; narrator current Navi+comma and item+colon avoid invariant Korean final-consonant particles. Dynamic widths/presentation still require runtime evidence.
ThunderMan item7 is placed, electricity flows into him and strengthening grants item33; do not invent the item name or a player menu.
WoodMan item6 grows into a tree; minus ions and healing power are fictional source narration preserved without outside health claims. Names 썬더맨/우드맨 and label 강화 프로그램 are review candidates.
Reward/strengthening hidden or never-shown system narration is not attributed to the last visible portrait. Prefix0 hints spoken by ThunderMan/WoodMan are distinguished from later narration.
ProtoMan failure apologizes and returns; no success reward or new retry choice. All variables/commands remain source-defined.
No normal-play collection/reward limits/item placements/growth/strengthening/mission return/name/save/screen verification. Static draft checks are not runtime proof.
